svg.title: Smart Home for AgentBuff: how work flows
svg.desc: 1. Buy the app (Home owner): The owner buys Buff Tuya in the AgentBuff marketplace for a one-time price. 2. Connector installed (AgentBuff): AgentBuff installs the MCP connector and companion skill on the owner's agent, with no token to paste. 3. Sign in (Home owner): The owner opens the web app and signs in with AgentBuff. 4. Get the home key (Home owner): The wizard guides the owner to tuya.ai, where scanning a QR code with the Smart Life app creates an sk- key. 5. Paste and discover (Buff Tuya): The key is checked with Tuya, encrypted, and the homes, rooms and devices appear in the app. 6. Ask in chat (Home owner): The owner writes what they want in their own words, for example the AC at 24 degrees, cool mode. 7. Agent acts (AI agent): The agent calls a tool, the server sends the command and checks that the device reported the change. 8. Home runs itself (Buff Tuya): Schedules and automations run in the background and every action lands in the activity log.
svg.text: From the first step to the last, and who does what.
